# Third Industries LLC

Third Industries LLC is the holding company for Peter Salvato's public-facing properties.

## Properties

- **petersalvato.com** — The practice. Design and brand consulting, methodology, client work.
- **joineryschool.com** — The school. Design systems and AI-augmented creative work.
- **journeymanshow.com** — The show. Cross-domain creative practice through brand walks, conversations, and connections.

## Founder

Peter Salvato
